text: Hey, you wanted to ask me something about the schedule? Yes, could you cover my Saturday shift? My cousin is getting married that day. Congratulations to your cousin! I could do it, but I am already working Friday night. I understand. Would it help if I took your Friday night shift in exchange? That would actually work perfectly. Let me confirm with the manager before we make it official. Sounds good. I will email the manager too so everything is clear in writing. The manager usually needs both of us to confirm the exact times. I will include both shift times in my message. Once the manager approves, I will put the change on the shared calendar. Thanks. I will check the calendar after we receive approval.
